title: Configuration
description: Configures the source files, page layout, theme, output location, and quality checks used to generate a documentation site.

$schema.description: Not recommended in configuration files. Retained only for compatibility. The canonical hosted schema represents the latest Kampose release and may not match an installed or pinned version, and installation-relative schema paths are not portable. Kampose does not use this value during generation. Editors and agents should instead validate out of band using the schema matching every effective Kampose version.

baseDirectory.description: Directory used to resolve relative assembly, XML documentation, topic, asset, and output paths. If null or omitted, the directory containing this configuration file is used.

baseUrl.description: Absolute root URL assigned to the generated documentation site. If null or omitted, generated links are relative so the output can be hosted at any location.

assemblies.description: Case-insensitive glob patterns, relative to baseDirectory, that select .NET assemblies to document. Patterns without an extension are treated as .dll patterns. For every matched assembly, a same-named .xml file in the same directory is loaded automatically when present.

xmlDocs.description: Case-insensitive glob patterns, relative to baseDirectory, for additional XML documentation files. Patterns without an extension are treated as .xml patterns. Use this field when XML files are not located beside, or are not named after, their assemblies.

namespaces.description: Case-sensitive namespace patterns whose external types and members use this reference. A pattern may end with a single wildcard (*) segment to match descendant namespaces.

strategy.description: URL convention used to construct links for matching external code elements: .NET API Browser, DocFX, Azure DevOps Wiki, or an online search query.

url.description: Absolute base URL of the external documentation site, or the search endpoint when strategy is onlineSearch.

extension.description: Override for the page extension produced by a strategy-based reference. Set to an empty or whitespace-only string to omit extensions; use null or omit the field to retain the strategy's default. This field does not affect onlineSearch references.

items.description: Maps a set of external namespaces to the documentation site and URL convention used to link their types and members.

references.description: Rules for linking referenced types and members that are not part of the documented assemblies. Rules associate namespace patterns with an external documentation site and URL convention.

topics.description: Case-insensitive glob patterns, relative to baseDirectory, that select Markdown topic files such as guides and tutorials. Patterns without an extension are treated as .md patterns. The default selects Markdown files directly inside baseDirectory.

topicOrder.description: Topic paths to place first, in the listed order. Matching is case-insensitive and accepts relative paths or filenames with or without extensions. Unlisted topics follow in alphabetical title order; unmatched entries are ignored. If empty, all topics are sorted alphabetically by title.

topicHierarchy.description: Method for deriving parent-child relationships between topics: none keeps every topic at the top level; directory makes a file named after a directory the parent of that directory's files; index uses overview files as parents; prefix groups filenames by dot-separated prefixes.

source.description: Case-insensitive glob patterns, relative to baseDirectory, that select files to copy unchanged. Prefix a pattern with ! to exclude matches.

targetPath.description: Destination directory under outputDirectory. Each matched file is copied into this directory using its filename; source subdirectories are not preserved. An empty or omitted value copies files directly into outputDirectory.

items.description: Selects static files and the output subdirectory into which they are copied.

assets.description: Static asset copy rules for files such as images, stylesheets, and scripts. Assets are copied unchanged and can overwrite another asset assigned to the same destination path.

outputDirectory.description: Directory that receives generated pages, theme bundles, and copied assets. A relative path is resolved against baseDirectory. The directory is created when needed and may be cleared first when the build command uses --clean.

convention.description: Determines output format, page grouping, URL layout, and the directory from which built-in themes are loaded. dotNet generates HTML with separate type and member pages; docFx generates HTML with members on their type pages; devOps generates Markdown for Azure DevOps Wiki.

theme.description: Theme directory to load for the selected convention. Use a built-in theme name such as "classic" or an absolute path to a custom theme directory containing theme.json. Relative values are resolved beneath Kampose's format-specific themes directory.

themeSettings.description: Values supplied to the selected theme. A non-null value overrides the parameter's default from theme.json; unknown names are still exposed to templates and scripts for custom use. Parameter names are matched case-insensitively.

audit.description: Controls XML documentation completeness checks and link validation performed before pages are written.

options.description: XML documentation elements or rule groups to inspect. Use required for minimum requirements, recommended for suggested elements, all for every supported check, or list individual element names. An empty array disables XML documentation inspection but does not disable link checking.

includeImplicitConstructors.description: Whether compiler-generated public constructors must satisfy the selected XML documentation checks. They are omitted from inspection by default.

verifyExternalLinks.description: Whether link validation may make network requests to check external URLs found in XML comments and Markdown topics. Internal references are validated regardless of this setting.

stopOnIssues.description: Whether missing XML documentation, reported documentation issues, or invalid links cause the build to fail instead of being reported as warnings.
